page.notes: The left-hand strip (fragments such as "gelitis", "Diff.", "nefici", "Theo", "Ponti") is the edge of the neighbouring page and was left out. The underline under "Quibus vero" and the ink flourish at the right of the rule are handwriting and were left out. "diversmo-dos" at the line end is read from a worn edge; the first part may be "diversmo" with a long s and is not certain. The Greek accents are read from a small, slightly blurred print.
